raw_note: Friction: refreeze-chain uses version-only feature_package_authoritative() check instead of feature-aware check. When running 'beacon change --refreeze-chain' for a feature at v0.0.1 with truth.md frontmatter truth_source_model=feature_package_authoritative, the refreeze still requires legacy PRD/user-story/test-case surfaces because _semver_tuple('v0.0.1') >= (1,5,2) is False. Root cause: change_refreeze.py line 288-292 calls feature_package_authoritative(resolved_version) which is version-only, but truth_map_supported_for_feature() already exists at truth_map.py:215 which checks feature_package_ready() on disk. Repair: either (a) make feature_package_authoritative() accept project_root+feature params, or (b) change_refreeze should call truth_map_supported_for_feature() or resolve_truth_read_refs() first to derive the model from resolved refs. Impact: operator in old-version project (v0.0.1) with package-authoritative truth must manually write PRD/user-story/test-case compatibility mirrors to bypass blocking.
